properties.name: api-endpoint
properties.description: A variable for providing a version of API with requests

properties.name: cookie-same-site
properties.description: A SameSite vaue for cookie setting. Lax, None or Strict. Lax to work with localhost. None for production only with HTTPS (SSL sertificate)

properties.name: frontend-domain
properties.description: A frontend domain URL for CORS security filter

properties.name: jwt-secret
properties.description: JWT secret for generating access and refresh auth tokens

properties.name: access-token-duration-minutes
properties.description: A duration in minutes of JWT access token and cookie with it

properties.name: refresh-token-duration-days
properties.description: A duration in days of JWT refresh token and cookie with it
